{{Quote|What's that?''"<br />"''The newest toy on Gala. My grandfather sells them over on Victory Street.|A soldier and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />}}
'''Victory Street''' was a street in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zehava]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]].<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], along with [[Cerasi]] and [[Nield]]&mdash;members of [[the Young]], a group opposed to the [[Melida/Daan Civil War|civil war]] between the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] factions&mdash;was stopped on a street in Zehava by Daan [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. When one [[Unidentified Daan soldier 2|soldier]] noticed Kenobi's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], he claimed it was a toy from<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" /> the planet<ref name="Crown">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref> [[Gala]] sold by his grandfather on Victory Street, a lie the soldiers believed.<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />

==Behind the scenes==
Victory Street was mentioned in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]'', a [[1999]] young-readers novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' series.<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />
